{"id":"persona-vvs2.7","title":"Second-instance refusal has no named-pipe equivalent","description":"hire-grpc/src/server.rs:17-21 and :62-64 hold a decision recorded in the second-personad-refuses memory: a second daemon REFUSES to start when a live one holds the socket, detected by an exclusive non-blocking flock on <socket>.lock taken BEFORE the stale-socket unlink. The comment at server.rs:17 records the lifetime requirement -- '_lock must stay alive for as long as this server serves'.

The mechanism is chosen specifically because the KERNEL RELEASES A FLOCK WHEN ITS HOLDER DIES, which is the live-vs-dead question a socket path cannot answer. None of that transfers.

WHY IT MATTERS RATHER THAN BEING A TIDY-UP: the memory records what the check prevents. Two daemons hold different ephemeral signing keys and different pseudonym_ikm, so a silent takeover re-homes every consumer to new pseudonyms and to a JWKS without the kid on its existing token -- logging only 'removed stale socket'. That failure is platform-independent even though the fix is not.

Named pipes may make part of this free: creating a pipe instance with FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE fails if one exists, so the bind itself can refuse. Verify that rather than assuming it, and check what happens when the holder dies -- the flock property being relied on is specifically about crash recovery, and a pipe handle closing on process death may or may not give the same guarantee. A named mutex is the other candidate.

Also note there is no path to unlink, so the stale-socket cleanup this lock guards has no analogue either (persona-vvs2.2).","acceptance_criteria":"A second hired on Windows refuses to start against a live one and starts cleanly after a crash; the mechanism verified empirically, as the flock behaviour was; the takeover failure mode named in the bead cannot occur.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-15T21:01:30.923701308Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-09-15T21:01:30.923701308Z","labels":["windows","portability"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"persona-vvs2.7","depends_on_id":"persona-vvs2","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-09-15T21:01:30.95262206Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
